# @loom/plugin-kit

Type helpers for authoring Loom plugins — preset contracts (e.g. StoragePreset) so a plugin's wiring is type-checked, with no dependency on @loom/app.

## Entry points

- `@loom/plugin-kit`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
